definitions.explanation: The title or heading of a written work, document, email, or similar item. A formal word for 'title' often used in written and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {表題|ひょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とおりです。
examples.english: It is as stated in the subject line.

examples.japanese: {表題|ひょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{回答|かいとう}→回答：00142_kaitou⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I will respond regarding the matter stated in the subject.

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表題|ひょうだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{的確|てきかく}→的確：04536_tekikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧もので⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: The title of a thesis must accurately represent its content.

notes:
USAGE:
{表題|ひょうだい} is a formal word most commonly encountered in business emails and official documents. The phrase {表題|ひょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧ (the matter in the subject line) is a standard opening in business correspondence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表題|ひょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧ (the matter in the subject)
- {表題|ひょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とおり (as per the title/subject)
- {表題|ひょうだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (give a title)
- {表題|ひょうだい}⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧ (title track — of an album)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧: title (loanword, more casual and versatile)
- ⟦{題名|だいめい}→題名：03421_daimei⟧: title of a work (books, films, etc.)
- {標題|ひょうだい}: title, heading (same reading, used interchangeably in some contexts)
- ⟦{件名|けんめい}→件名：11552_kenmei⟧: subject line (specifically for emails)
